anchors.description: 3D straight-line distance across the top of the spindle-back wooden dining chair, from the left end of its crest rail to the top of its right rear stile (chair back width).
anchors.visible_evidence: Dark curved crest rail of a spindle-back wooden chair, seen from behind against a bright window blind; the rail's continuous top edge runs at y~258-260 from candidate corner v1:p0 (left rail end) to v1:p1 (right rear stile top), both lying on the dark chair wood.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Make/model is not identifiable; typical domestic side chairs are 0.40-0.48 m wide across the back, but a narrow accent chair (~0.36 m) or a wide chair (~0.50 m) cannot be excluded. Both points are a few pixels inside the outer rail corners, so the measured span is slightly below the outer back width, and the rail is slightly bowed, so the straight chord is a little shorter than the arc.
